--[[
    ANXY HUB  v5.0  ·  monochrome marble edition

    * black & white theme with an animated marbled-ink background
    * sidebar tabs: Farming / Upgrades / Eggs / Settings
    * the marble texture is embedded at the bottom of this file. On first run it is
      written to your executor's workspace folder (anxy_marble_v5.jpg) with writefile
      and loaded with getcustomasset. If your executor has neither, the hub falls
      back to a drifting smoke effect made from plain frames.
]]

local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CoreGui           = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local TweenService      = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService  = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService        = game:GetService("RunService")

local GUI_NAME = "AnxyHub_v5"
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- RE-EXECUTE CLEANUP (stops old loops + removes any older Anxy GUI)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
if env.AnxyHubShutdown then pcall(env.AnxyHubShutdown) end
for _, n in ipairs({ "AnxyHub_v5", "AnxyHub_v4", "AnxyHubGui" }) do
    local stale = CoreGui:FindFirstChild(n)
    if stale then stale:Destroy() end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TASK MANAGER
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local TaskManager = { _tasks = {} }

function TaskManager:start(id, fn, interval)
    self:stop(id)
    local entry = { alive = true }
    self._tasks[id] = entry
    task.spawn(function()
        while entry.alive do
            pcall(fn)
            task.wait(interval)
        end
    end)
end

function TaskManager:stop(id)
    local entry = self._tasks[id]
    if entry then
        entry.alive = false
        self._tasks[id] = nil
    end
end

function TaskManager:stopAll()
    for id in pairs(self._tasks) do
        self:stop(id)
    end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- REMOTES (cached, re-resolved if they disappear)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local cachedPort
local function port1()
    if cachedPort and cachedPort.Parent then return cachedPort end
    local network = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Network")
    cachedPort = network and network:FindFirstChild("Port1")
    return cachedPort
end

local function fire(...)
    local p = port1()
    if p then p:FireServer(...) end
end

local function increaseSpeed()
    local ev = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("IncreaseSpeed")
    if ev then ev:FireServer() end
end

local punchTarget
local function getPunchTarget()
    if punchTarget and punchTarget.Parent then return punchTarget end
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PowerTrainingFolder")
    punchTarget = folder and folder:GetChildren()[16]
    return punchTarget
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PALETTE (strictly monochrome)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local C = {
    Black     = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    White     = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    Text      = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240),
    TextSub   = Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 175),
    TextMuted = Color3.fromRGB(125, 125, 125),
    KnobOff   = Color3.fromRGB(135, 135, 135),
    TrackOff  = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
}

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function tw(obj, t, props)
    TweenService:Create(obj,
        TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        props):Play()
end

local function new(class, props, parent)
    local inst = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
    inst.Parent = parent
    return inst
end

local function frame(parent, props)
    local p = { BackgroundColor3 = C.Black, BorderSizePixel = 0 }
    for k, v in pairs(props) do p[k] = v end
    return new("Frame", p, parent)
end

local function label(parent, props)
    local p = {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.Text,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }
    for k, v in pairs(props) do p[k] = v end
    return new("TextLabel", p, parent)
end

local function corner(inst, px)
    return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, px) }, inst)
end

local function round(inst)
    return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, inst)
end

local function stroke(inst, color, thickness, transparency)
    return new("UIStroke", {
        Color = color, Thickness = thickness or 1, Transparency = transparency or 0,
    }, inst)
end

local function clamp(x, lo, hi)
    if x < lo then return lo end
    if x > hi then return hi end
    return x
end

-- "TRAINING" -> "T R A I N I N G"  (Roblox text has no letter-spacing property)
local function spaced(s)
    return (s:upper():gsub("(.)", "%1 "):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end

local conns = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    conns[#conns + 1] = c
    return c
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ROOT
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local ScreenGui = new("ScreenGui", {
    Name           = GUI_NAME,
    ResetOnSpawn   = false,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
    DisplayOrder   = 100,
}, nil)
if not pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui end) then
    ScreenGui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local function shutdown()
    TaskManager:stopAll()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    if ScreenGui and ScreenGui.Parent then ScreenGui:Destroy() end
    if env.AnxyHubShutdown == shutdown then env.AnxyHubShutdown = nil end
end
env.AnxyHubShutdown = shutdown

local WIN_W, WIN_H = 480, 504
local NAV_W        = 118
local TOPBAR_H     = 56

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- WINDOW SHELL: silver animated ring + rounded panel
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local Outer = new("Frame", {
    Name = "Outer",
    Size = UDim2.new(0, WIN_W, 0, WIN_H),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -WIN_W / 2, 0.5, -WIN_H / 2),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, ScreenGui)

local Ring = frame(Outer, { Name = "Ring", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C.White })
corner(Ring, 18)
local RingGrad = new("UIGradient", {
    Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    }),
}, Ring)

-- A CanvasGroup clips its children to the rounded corners (a plain Frame does
-- not). If it is unavailable we fall back to a normal clipped Frame.
local canvasOk, Panel = pcall(Instance.new, "CanvasGroup")
local isCanvas = canvasOk
if not canvasOk then Panel = Instance.new("Frame") end
Panel.Name = "Panel"
Panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4)
Panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 2)
Panel.BackgroundColor3 = C.Black
Panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
if not isCanvas then Panel.ClipsDescendants = true end
Panel.Parent = Outer
corner(Panel, 16)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BACKGROUND: animated marble (layer 1 under everything in the panel)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local Bg = frame(Panel, {
    Name = "Bg", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 1,
})

local function marbleLayer(size, transparency, z)
    return new("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Marble",
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Image = "",
        ImageTransparency = transparency,
        ZIndex = z,
    }, Bg)
end
local LayerA = marbleLayer(840, 0, 1)      -- main marble
local LayerB = marbleLayer(900, 0.76, 2)   -- ghost layer, counter-rotating

-- fallback smoke (only shown when the texture can't be loaded)
local discs = {}
for i, size in ipairs({ 430, 360, 300 }) do
    local f = frame(Bg, {
        Name = "Smoke", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.White, ZIndex = 2 + i, Visible = false,
    })
    round(f)
    local g = new("UIGradient", {
        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.78),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        }),
    }, f)
    discs[i] = { frame = f, grad = g }
end

-- dark veil: keeps text readable; its strength is the "Marble Brightness" slider
local Veil = frame(Bg, {
    Name = "Veil", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.64, ZIndex = 10,
})

-- everything interactive lives above the background
local Content = new("Frame", {
    Name = "Content", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2,
}, Panel)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STATE SHARED WITH THE ANIMATION LOOP
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local minimized   = false
local bgOn        = true
local flow        = 1
local uiT, marbleT = 0, 0
local useFallback = false
local sparkles    = {}

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOP BAR
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local TopBar = frame(Content, {
    Name = "TopBar", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TOPBAR_H), BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
})
local ShineGrad

-- status pill (needs to exist before updateStatus)
local activeCount = 0
local StatusPill = frame(TopBar, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0.5, -12),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
})
round(StatusPill)
stroke(StatusPill, C.White, 1, 0.7)
local StatusDot = frame(StatusPill, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0.5, -3), BackgroundColor3 = C.TextMuted,
})
round(StatusDot)
local StatusText = label(StatusPill, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 0),
    Text = "0 active", TextColor3 = C.TextSub, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
})

local function updateStatus(delta)
    activeCount = math.max(0, activeCount + delta)
    StatusText.Text = activeCount .. " active"
    local on = activeCount > 0
    tw(StatusPill, 0.2, {
        BackgroundColor3 = on and C.White or C.Black,
        BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.35,
    })
    tw(StatusText, 0.2, { TextColor3 = on and C.Black or C.TextSub })
    tw(StatusDot, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = on and C.Black or C.TextMuted })
end

local function sparkle(parent, x, size, phase)
    local root = new("Frame", {
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    }, parent)
    local parts = {
        frame(root, { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.White }),
        frame(root, { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C.White }),
        frame(root, { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3), Rotation = 45, BackgroundColor3 = C.White }),
    }
    sparkles[#sparkles + 1] = { root = root, parts = parts, size = size, phase = phase }
end

local function iconButton(xOffset, kind)
    local btn = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, xOffset, 0.5, -14),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.White, BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
        Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, TopBar)
    corner(btn, 8)
    local bars = {}
    local function bar(w, h, rot)
        local b = frame(btn, {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h), Rotation = rot or 0, BackgroundColor3 = C.White,
        })
        bars[#bars + 1] = b
        return b
    end
    local plus
    if kind == "close" then
        bar(12, 2, 45); bar(12, 2, -45)
    else
        bar(11, 2, 0)
        plus = bar(2, 11, 0)
        plus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    end
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if kind == "close" then
            tw(btn, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
            for _, b in ipairs(bars) do tw(b, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = C.Black }) end
        else
            tw(btn, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.75 })
        end
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tw(btn, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 })
        if kind == "close" then
            for _, b in ipairs(bars) do tw(b, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = C.White }) end
        end
    end)
    return btn, plus
end

do
    -- hairline + travelling shine under the bar
    frame(TopBar, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.White, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88,
    })
    local shine = frame(TopBar, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1), BackgroundColor3 = C.White,
    })
    ShineGrad = new("UIGradient", {
        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        }),
        Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0),
    }, shine)

    sparkle(TopBar, 20, 16, 0)
    label(TopBar, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0.5, -14),
        Text = "ANXY  HUB", TextColor3 = C.White, TextSize = 17, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
    })
    local badge = frame(TopBar, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0, 146, 0.5, -9), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    })
    round(badge)
    stroke(badge, C.White, 1, 0.55)
    label(badge, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Text = "v5.0", TextColor3 = C.TextSub,
        TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    })
    sparkle(TopBar, 196, 8, 2.1)
end

local MinBtn, MinPlus = iconButton(-74, "min")
local CloseBtn        = iconButton(-40, "close")

MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    tw(Outer, 0.3, { Size = UDim2.new(0, WIN_W, 0, minimized and (TOPBAR_H + 4) or WIN_H) })
    tw(MinPlus, 0.2, { BackgroundTransparency = minimized and 0 or 1 })
end)

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    TaskManager:stopAll()
    tw(Outer, 0.25, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
    })
    task.delay(0.28, shutdown)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- DRAG (top bar)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local dragging, dragOrigin, dragStart = false, nil, nil

local function isPointer(input)
    return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

TopBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if isPointer(input) then
        dragging   = true
        dragOrigin = input.Position
        dragStart  = Outer.Position
    end
end)

connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
    if isPointer(input) then dragging = false end
end)

connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local d = input.Position - dragOrigin
        Outer.Position = UDim2.new(
            dragStart.X.Scale, dragStart.X.Offset + d.X,
            dragStart.Y.Scale, dragStart.Y.Offset + d.Y
        )
    end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SIDEBAR + CONTENT AREA
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local Sidebar = frame(Content, {
    Name = "Sidebar", Size = UDim2.new(0, NAV_W, 1, -TOPBAR_H), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, TOPBAR_H),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
})
frame(Content, {
    Name = "SideRule", Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -TOPBAR_H), Position = UDim2.new(0, NAV_W, 0, TOPBAR_H),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.White, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88,
})

-- white pill that slides behind the active tab
local NavPill = frame(Sidebar, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 38), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 12),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.White, ZIndex = 1,
})
corner(NavPill, 10)

local KeyHint = label(Sidebar, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -38),
    Text = "RightShift  ·  show / hide", TextColor3 = C.TextMuted, TextSize = 10,
    TextWrapped = true, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom,
})

local ContentArea = new("Frame", {
    Name = "ContentArea",
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -NAV_W - 1, 1, -TOPBAR_H),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, NAV_W + 1, 0, TOPBAR_H),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true,
}, Content)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TABS (buttons are positioned by hand, no layout object to go wrong)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local tabs = {}
local activeTab = nil
local orders = {}
local function nextOrder(pane)
    orders[pane] = (orders[pane] or 0) + 1
    return orders[pane]
end

local function paintTab(t, on)
    tw(t.name, 0.2, { TextColor3 = on and C.Black or C.TextSub })
    tw(t.num,  0.2, { TextColor3 = on and C.Black or C.TextMuted, TextTransparency = on and 0.35 or 0 })
end

local function selectTab(t)
    if activeTab == t then return end
    if activeTab then
        activeTab.pane.Visible = false
        paintTab(activeTab, false)
    end
    activeTab = t
    t.pane.Visible = true
    t.pane.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
    tw(t.pane, 0.25, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) })
    paintTab(t, true)
    tw(NavPill, 0.28, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 12 + (t.index - 1) * 44) })
end

local function addTab(title)
    local index = #tabs + 1
    local btn = new("TextButton", {
        Name = title .. "Nav",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 38),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 12 + (index - 1) * 44),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 2,
    }, Sidebar)
    local num = label(btn, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 0),
        Text = string.format("%02d", index), TextColor3 = C.TextMuted, TextSize = 9,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    })
    local name = label(btn, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 0),
        Text = title, TextColor3 = C.TextSub, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
    })

    local pane = new("ScrollingFrame", {
        Name = title .. "Pane",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.White, ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.4,
        ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
        AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Visible = false,
    }, ContentArea)
    new("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 8) }, pane)
    new("UIPadding", {
        PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 14),
        PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14),
    }, pane)

    local data = { index = index, btn = btn, num = num, name = name, pane = pane }
    tabs[index] = data

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() selectTab(data) end)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if activeTab ~= data then tw(name, 0.15, { TextColor3 = C.White }) end
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if activeTab ~= data then tw(name, 0.15, { TextColor3 = C.TextSub }) end
    end)
    return pane
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- COMPONENTS
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function addSection(pane, title)
    local f = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(pane),
    }, pane)
    label(f, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 8),
        Text = spaced(title), TextColor3 = C.White, TextTransparency = 0.25,
        TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    })
    local rule = frame(f, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.White,
    })
    new("UIGradient", {
        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        }),
    }, rule)
end

-- glass card: dark, translucent, hairline border
local function card(pane, height)
    local c = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height), BackgroundColor3 = C.Black,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(pane),
    }, pane)
    corner(c, 12)
    local s = stroke(c, C.White, 1, 0.84)
    return c, s
end

-- outlined button that inverts on hover
local function addButton(pane, text, height)
    local btn = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 44), BackgroundColor3 = C.Black,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false,
        Text = text, TextColor3 = C.White, TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        LayoutOrder = nextOrder(pane),
    }, pane)
    corner(btn, 12)
    stroke(btn, C.White, 1, 0.6)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tw(btn, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = C.White, BackgroundTransparency = 0, TextColor3 = C.Black })
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tw(btn, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = C.Black, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, TextColor3 = C.White })
    end)
    return btn
end

local featureToggles = {}

-- returns: setter, sublabel
local function addToggle(pane, title, sublabel, callback, opts)
    local countable = not (opts and opts.countable == false)
    local state = false

    local c, cardStroke = card(pane, 58)

        tw(glow,        0.22, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 })
        if countable then updateStatus(on and 1 or -1) end

    return set, sub

local function addLoop(pane, id, title, sublabel, interval, fn)
    return addToggle(pane, title, sublabel, function(on)
        if on then
            TaskManager:start(id, fn, interval)
        else
            TaskManager:stop(id)
        end
    end)
end

local function addSlider(pane, title, min, max, init, suffix, onChange)
    local c = card(pane, 60)
    label(c, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 10),
        Text = title, TextColor3 = C.TextSub, TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
    })
    local valueLbl = label(c, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(0.7, -16, 0, 10),
        Text = init .. suffix, TextColor3 = C.White, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
    })
    local rel0 = (init - min) / (max - min)
    local track = frame(c, {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 4), Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 41),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.White, BackgroundTransparency = 0.85,
    })
    round(track)
    local fill = frame(track, { Size = UDim2.new(rel0, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = C.White })
    round(fill)
    local knob = frame(track, {
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(rel0, 0, 0.5, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12), BackgroundColor3 = C.White,
    })
    round(knob)
    local hit = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 26), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 31),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 5,
    }, c)

    local sliding = false
    local function apply(x)
        local w = math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
        local rel = clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / w, 0, 1)
        local v = math.floor(min + (max - min) * rel + 0.5)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 0.5, 0)
        valueLbl.Text = v .. suffix
        onChange(v)
    end
    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if isPointer(input) then
            sliding = true
            apply(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if sliding and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            apply(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if isPointer(input) then sliding = false end
    end)
end

local lastClock = os.clock()
connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
    local now = os.clock()
    local dt = math.min(now - lastClock, 0.1)
    lastClock = now
    if not Outer.Visible then return end

    uiT = uiT + dt
    RingGrad.Rotation = (uiT * 36) % 360
    ShineGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(-1 + (uiT * 0.5) % 2.6, 0)

    for _, s in ipairs(sparkles) do
        local k = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(uiT * 1.9 + s.phase)
        local px = s.size * (0.6 + 0.5 * k)
        s.root.Size = UDim2.new(0, px, 0, px)
        for _, p in ipairs(s.parts) do p.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 - 0.5 * k end
    end

    if activeCount > 0 then
        StatusDot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(uiT * 4))
    else
        StatusDot.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    end

    if not bgOn or minimized then return end
    marbleT = marbleT + dt * flow
    local t = marbleT

    if useFallback then
        for i, d in ipairs(discs) do
            d.frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                0.5 + 0.30 * math.sin(t * 0.30 + i * 2.1), 0,
                0.5 + 0.30 * math.cos(t * 0.23 + i * 1.7), 0)
            d.grad.Rotation = (t * (18 + i * 9)) % 360
        end
    else
        local sA = 840 + 36 * math.sin(t * 0.13)
        LayerA.Rotation = (t * 4.5) % 360
        LayerA.Size = UDim2.new(0, sA, 0, sA)
        LayerA.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 26 * math.sin(t * 0.21), 0.5, 26 * math.cos(t * 0.17))

        LayerB.Size = UDim2.new(0, sB, 0, sB)
        LayerB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 30 * math.cos(t * 0.15 + 0.8), 0.5, 30 * math.sin(t * 0.19 + 2.0))
        LayerB.ImageTransparency = 0.76 + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 0.35)
    end
end)

local B64_CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64decode(data)
    local lookup = {}
    for i = 1, 64 do lookup[B64_CHARS:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
    data = data:gsub("[^%w%+/=]", "")
    local out, n = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #data, 4 do
        local c1, c2, c3, c4 = data:byte(i, i + 3)
        local a, b, c, d = lookup[c1], lookup[c2], lookup[c3], lookup[c4]
        local v = a * 262144 + b * 4096 + (c or 0) * 64 + (d or 0)
        n = n + 1
        if c and d then
            out[n] = string.char(math.floor(v / 65536) % 256, math.floor(v / 256) % 256, v % 256)
        elseif c then
            out[n] = string.char(math.floor(v / 65536) % 256, math.floor(v / 256) % 256)
        else
            out[n] = string.char(math.floor(v / 65536) % 256)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local function loadMarble()
    local getAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
    if not (writefile and getAsset) then return nil end
    local name = "anxy_marble_v5.jpg"
    local ok, asset = pcall(function()
        local need = true
        if isfile and readfile and isfile(name) then
            local okRead, existing = pcall(readfile, name)
            if okRead and type(existing) == "string" and #existing == MARBLE_BYTES then need = false end
        end
        if need then writefile(name, b64decode(MARBLE_B64)) end
        return getAsset(name)
    end)
    if ok and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then return asset end
    return nil
end
